sessions.text: My dog is called Biscuit and I am allergic to peanuts.
Noted, Biscuit sounds lovely.
Can you suggest a holiday in Japan?
Try Kyoto in autumn.
I live in Hanoi and work as a nurse.
Tell me a fun fact about owls.
I moved to Da Nang last month.
My salary is 50k per year.
Please forget my salary, I should not have shared it.
My manager is Linh and she prefers short emails.
